draft.subject: Following up on inviting your teammate
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad Tariq was able to close the loop on your question last week — just to confirm, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. If you're bringing on more than one person, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

I also saw you created your first project for Bright Ventures, which is the best possible start. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week help to get your teammate set up and working in that project? Happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Nadia
